Subject: CloudHaven & Redwood — solution workshop / architecture deep-dive scheduling

Hi Emma — great to meet last week on the partner call. We'd like to run a joint solution workshop focused on the CloudHaven marketplace integration and operator runbook for customers who will deploy Redwood in a VPC. Goal is to produce a marketplace-ready architecture diagram, an integration checklist, and an initial deployment runbook.

Proposed format: 75-minute technical deep-dive, followed by an optional 30-minute marketplace listing Q&A. Suggested windows next week (all PT):
- Tue Dec 1: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Dec 2: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu Dec 3: 09:00–11:00

Attached is a short draft agenda and a preliminary network diagram (cloudhaven-redwood-draft-agenda.pdf, network-diagram.png). Can you confirm who from CloudHaven would attend (infra lead, product, marketplace PM)? Also please flag any hard constraints (e.g., no afternoons ET).

If those windows don't work, we can send a quick Doodle/poll. Once we lock time, we’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a preread packet.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the preread. If you can confirm external attendee emails (Tanya, others), I’ll include them.
